message: The other day, I was rummaging through my closet looking for something when I stumbled upon our family go-bags. Let's just say they were a little more like a time capsule! I found a half-eaten granola bar from last summer and a very crinkled map of the local park. 😂 It reminded me how easy it is to let preparedness slide into a comedy of errors. So, I took a moment to refresh our supplies, adding some snacks that actually have a future and updating our emergency plan. It’s a gentle nudge that being ready doesn't have to be perfect, just a little more thoughtful. What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared without the stress?
